t: How the Field-Level Equivalence Detector works (Signature)
title: How the Field-Level Equivalence Detector works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Field-Level Equivalence Detector does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach fuses three evidence signals — value overlap, pattern match, name similarity — with frozen weights into a deterministic equivalence score, so the same warehouse always yields the same field groups. Each group carries its pairwise evidence ledger, and transitive merges are re-checked for consistency before they stick. Borderline groups wait in review with their evidence attached. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
